description: GLM-4 uses standard OpenAI-compatible JSON function-calling format. GLM-5.3-Flash on vLLM (verified 2026-10-29) uses the same shape: function.arguments is a JSON string and tool-call ids are chatcmpl-tool-<hex>; the glm-5.3 cases are those calls flattened to {id, name, arguments}.

format_definitions.name: two tools
format_definitions.expected: [{"type":"function","function":{"name":"get_weather","description":"Get current weather for a location","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"location":{"type":"string","description":"City name, e.g. 'Tokyo'"},"unit":{"type":"string","enum":["celsius","fahrenheit"],"default":"celsius"}},"required":["location"]}}},{"type":"function","function":{"name":"search_web","description":"Search the web for information","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"query":{"type":"string","description":"Search query"}},"required":["query"]}}}]

parse_calls.name: glm-5.3 single call, arguments as JSON string
